login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the email address and password of your school account.

register.noSchools: Registration is not available at the moment.
register.profileSubtitle: Your email is confirmed. Provide the remaining details to finish registration.

verify.codeHint: The code from the email (6 digits).
